prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a complete 16:9 background for a 2D educational pixel-art RPG minigame called Terra-Mar. Create a beautifully crafted game environment, crisp controlled pixel clusters, no blurred or photographic surfaces, warm ochre and jade palette matching a sophisticated Brazilian cultural pixel RPG. A contemporary Mozambican coastal school playground: low limewashed coral and cream buildings with shaded verandas, a cashew tree, distant Indian Ocean glimpses outside the playground. The ENTIRE central playing surface is a safe dry level sandy courtyard, empty and clearly readable; a single straight vertical white chalk line divides two dry painted play areas, warm golden sand on the left and a muted turquoise painted rectangle on the right, representing land and sea. Never put playable children in actual water. Depth only in the upper third; generous uncluttered foreground and center for animated sprites and exact game controls to be overlaid by code. No people, no writing, no labels, no letters, no icons, no UI, no borders, no watermark. Wide landscape composition 1536x1024 or 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete wide background for a 2D pixel-art educational RPG attention minigame. Match a refined pixel RPG: visible precise pixel clusters, warm sun, ochre soil, sage foliage, terracotta and cream contemporary school architecture. A Tanzanian school courtyard at the green foothills of distant mountains, small shaded school veranda across the upper third, banana plants and broad-canopy trees at the edges. A large flat safe dry open central sandy playground with simple faded chalk semicircle, EMPTY and unobstructed for rows of animated participants to be drawn by code. The phrase Fire on the Mountain is a spoken game cue: there must be NO actual fire, NO smoke, NO eruption, NO danger. Respectful everyday African setting, no exotic fantasy ornaments, no safari theme. No people, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark. Wide landscape.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide game background and museum illustration backdrop for a seed-sowing Oware/Mancala minigame in a 2D pixel-art cultural RPG. Beautiful warm handcrafted pixel art with crisp clusters and consistent light, rich timber, jade, brass, clay and woven texture. A shaded Ghanaian community veranda with a LARGE EMPTY smooth dark honey-brown wooden tabletop occupying most of the lower two thirds, seen from a comfortable slightly elevated top-down angle. Upper third shows low earthen and painted masonry, airy veranda and a few plants, warm natural light. The actual 12-pit Oware board, all playing seeds, participants and score UI will be drawn separately by code, so DO NOT draw any board, pits, pieces, hands or people. The tabletop center must be very clear and unobstructed. No text, no numbers, no lettering, no watermark. Wide landscape.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a wide pixel-art RPG minigame background for Matacuzana, a Mozambican stone-tossing game. Carefully crafted warm pixel art, clear pixel clusters, jade and ochre palette, gentle directional sunlight, matching a polished educational 2D cultural RPG. A contemporary neighborhood courtyard in Mozambique: cream and coral masonry homes, green shutters, shaded veranda, leafy cashew tree and a low garden wall across the upper third. Large flat level earthen play surface over the lower two thirds. Near the center at 58% of image height, a small shallow round depression edged by one simple chalk circle; it is EMPTY, no loose stones yet. The animated stones, hand, baskets and participants will be separate sprites drawn by code. Keep the middle spacious and uncluttered. Everyday lived-in community, no fantasy, no safari. No people, no labels, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Wide landscape 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete wide game environment for an Afro-Brazilian passing-objects circle rhythm minigame in a cultural 2D pixel RPG. Warm sophisticated pixel illustration with distinct crisp pixel clusters, sunlit clay, jade green wood, golden lighting, coherent shadows. A Brazilian community cultural-center courtyard with cream walls and terracotta roof, green shutters, simple veranda, potted tropical foliage at the edges, a subtle distant hillside town glimpse. A large EMPTY broad circular straw-colored woven mat lies flat and grounded on the level stone courtyard in the middle/lower half, big enough for six seated players, with a narrow jade and terracotta woven border. No people, no cubes, no instruments: these are separate animated sprites. Make the center very legible and uncluttered. No text, no writing, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Wide landscape 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide background for Ampe, a Ghanaian clap-and-jump game, in a polished educational 2D pixel-art cultural RPG. Crisp warm pixel illustration with controlled clusters, ochre ground, jade greens and muted coral blue, beautiful grounded light and shade. A contemporary Ghanaian community school play court with low cream and blue school buildings, shaded veranda, lively plants, and a broad leafy shade tree at one edge. Open dry level sandy play space filling the lower two thirds, with TWO small opposing faded chalk semicircle marks on the court, lower center and upper center, to indicate face-to-face play. The center is empty: all kids, feet markers and score interface are drawn separately by code. No generic safari imagery, no grand fantasy temple, no thatched huts as a default cultural shorthand. No people, no text, no UI, no icons, no watermark. Wide landscape 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production animation sprite-sheet PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT background for a polished pixel-art 2D educational RPG. Precisely EIGHT columns by FOUR rows, 32 equal rectangular cells, no borders, no labels, no text, generous transparent gutters. Each row is ONE consistent distinct dark-skinned African teen participant in ordinary school/play clothes; row 1 boy with short curls, teal shirt, ochre shorts and sneakers; row 2 girl with two braids, coral shirt, blue trousers and sneakers; row 3 girl with short natural afro, golden shirt and jade trousers; row 4 boy with short twists, blue shirt and terracotta shorts. Respectful natural appearances, detailed charming small chibi RPG proportions consistent across ALL 32 sprites, no caricature. Every sprite is full body head to toe at SAME SCALE and grounded on the SAME foot baseline inside its cell. Each row repeats the SAME exact person in the following EIGHT poses, in this exact order: column 1 standing facing camera; column 2 standing seen from the BACK; column 3 front view extending anatomical LEFT foot forward (appears on viewer's right); column 4 front view anatomical RIGHT foot forward (viewer left); column 5 BACK view anatomical LEFT foot forward (viewer left); column 6 BACK view anatomical RIGHT foot forward (viewer right); column 7 airborne joyful clap with both hands together, knees lifted; column 8 crouching sideways with one hand reaching down to pick a small stone, no stone drawn. Crisp shaded pixel clusters, limited warm colors, clear silhouettes and precise hands/feet. No built-in ground, no baked shadows, no checkerboard painted into background. Output wide 2:1 sheet, ideal 2048x1024, exactly 8 equal columns x4 equal rows.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent-background production pixel-art game-prop atlas, exactly FOUR columns x TWO rows, eight equal square cells, each with a single centered clearly separated object and generous transparent padding. Match a warm polished cultural 2D RPG pixel style, crisp clusters, jade/ochre/wood palette, soft directional lighting, no outlines that are too thick, no writing or UI. Row 1 col1 a small open cloth pouch of golden smooth Oware seeds; col2 one smooth round gray throwing pebble; col3 one small chamfered wooden passing cube painted ochre and jade; col4 a neatly coiled white chalk-marking rope with two short chalk sticks. Row 2 col1 a shallow woven collecting basket, EMPTY; col2 a low museum wooden display plinth with brass feet and a blank small green plaque; col3 a small grounded clay planter with lush leaves; col4 a small teal triangular cloth game pennant on a short wooden stand. No people, no hands, no game boards, no scenery, no gradients around sprites, no text, no grids, no checkerboard painted as transparency, no cast shadow. Every object fully inside its cell; no crops. Genuine alpha background. Ideal image 2048x1024, exact 4x2 sheet.
